column7: RestoreEnvironment vs DeleteProject across replicas: the project-liveness check and the un-delete were separate statements and the cascade swept environments before touching the project row, leaving a live environment under a deleted project. RestoreEnvironment now un-deletes then re-reads the project FOR SHARE in one transaction; deleteProjectCascade row-locks the project before any child sweep (INV-STORE-21).
